name: React Aria Components
summary: The broadest accessible primitive set. React 19 dialog spike passed with role=dialog, an accessible label and focus inside; 277.23 KB / 88.22 KB gzip. The costs are a 68 MB install with React and no npm provenance.
gains: Strong keyboard, focus and screen-reader behaviour
losses: More verbose composition than copy-paste systems
Only the dialog primitive was spiked

spike.scenario: Dialog, React 19.2.0, plain CSS, Vite production build, 1200x800 Chrome screenshot.
spike.notes: role=dialog, labelledby present, focus inside the dialog. aria-modal was not observed on the role=dialog element in this simple composition.
